texts.name: Gertiz
texts.biography: Once a royal alchemist, Gertiz discovered the forbidden art of forging life essence into spectral flesh. For a heavy price in gold he can transmute ordinary Wights and Wraiths into powerful Blood Wraiths on the battlefield.

specialty.description:
{Wight / Wraith}

Special upgrades: Can upgrade Wights and Wraiths into Blood Wraiths. Additional spectral creatures from other mods can be upgraded when corresponding submods are enabled.
specialty.tooltip: Specialty: Upgrades ghosts to Blood Wraiths
specialty.name: Blood Soul Blacksmith
